methods.name: public boolean isDeclaredInManifest()
methods.comment:
* Return whether a shortcut is static; that is, whether a shortcut is * published from AndroidManifest.xml. If {@code true}, the shortcut is * also {@link #isImmutable()}. * *

When an app is upgraded and a shortcut is no longer published from AndroidManifest.xml, * this will be set to {@code false}. If the shortcut is not pinned, then it'll disappear. * However, if it's pinned, it will still be visible, {@link #isEnabled()} will be * {@code false} and {@link #isImmutable()} will be {@code true}.

methods.name: public boolean isImmutable()
methods.comment:
* Return if a shortcut is immutable, in which case it cannot be modified with any of * {@link ShortcutManagerCompat} APIs. * *

All static shortcuts are immutable. When a static shortcut is pinned and is then * disabled because it doesn't appear in AndroidManifest.xml for a newer version of the * app, {@link #isDeclaredInManifest} returns {@code false}, but the shortcut is still * immutable. * *

All shortcuts originally published via the {@link ShortcutManager} APIs * are all mutable.
